notes: Section 6, questions 1-14 of the answer key (answers.txt lines 1013-1528, PDF pages 16-21; 'page' is the PDF page, as in eval/reference.json). One item per table row or stated fact. Q6 rows are split per timestamp. 'Considerations' cells are not transcribed, except that the NT hashes they list are quoted in the Q6 account rows (the table's NT Hash column points to them). Q1 prints no row for RM#1 and no answer to 'does the hash match'. TIME ZONES. Q1, Q2, Q4, Q5, Q7, Q9, Q13, Q14: no times printed. Q3: install date printed as GMT, copied. Q8: printed as 'Eastern Time + DST', UTC-4. Q11, Q12: caption '(Timezone is applied)', read as Eastern Daylight Time, UTC-4 (default rule; Q12's last shutdown 11:31:00 agrees with Q8's 11:31:05, and Q11's last run 11:28:47 falls before it). Q6, Q10: same caption, but the printed times run one hour behind the rest of the key, i.e. Eastern Standard Time, UTC-5, daylight saving not applied (Q4 prints the zone as UTC-05:00). utc for Q6 and Q10 is therefore printed time + 5 h, NOT the default + 4 h; every such item has a note giving the + 4 h value, so the choice can be reversed mechanically. Evidence, all from the key itself: (a) Q6 informant created 09:33:54 is 14:33:54 UTC at UTC-5, 32 s before the install date Q3 prints in GMT (14:34:26); at UTC-4 the account would be an hour older than the installation. (b) Q6 informant last login 2015-03-25 09:45:59; Q12 lists an event at 10:45:59 that day. (c) At UTC-4 the Q6 accounts would be created 10:51:54-10:53:01, before the day's first logon in Q12 (11:00:08). (d) Q10 Chrome installed 2015-03-22 10:11:51; Q15 has the Chrome installer download at 11:11:06 and Chrome's welcome page at 11:11:58. (e) Q10 Apple Software Update 2015-03-23 15:01:01; Q11 AppleSoftwareUpdateIco.exe 16:00:59. (f) Q10 .NET Framework 4 installed 2015-03-25 09:51:39; Q11 has its setup program first run at 10:50:15. (g) At UTC-4 Q10's Office install (10:04:14) would precede the OS install date. MATCHERS. systemSetting: fixed names only; rows with no fitting name are null. Q1 hash rows carry 'exhibit' from the table's Class column, PC included. Q2: aux_contains on the contract's 'start sector S, sectors C' wording. programInstalled: obj_contains the printed name, aux the printed version; manufacturer and path are in 'nist' only. programRun: obj is the file name (last part of the printed path), exact. aux: a path tail ('\folder\file', aux_contains) on Shimcache and MuiCache rows and on rows with no time; none on Prefetch and UserAssist rows that have a time, because those artifacts may record no path or spell the leading folders differently. Execution counts are in 'nist' only. Where the key lists one run from two sources (Prefetch and UserAssist at the same second) the two items have the same matchers. sessionEvent: Q12 prints no account, so no aux; Q6 last-login rows have aux = account name. accountSeen: no aux matcher, the key does not print the contract's wording.
